description: Core’s readers of "not alive" under alive/1’s fact meaning (PL.core-alive-negation-readers, U117(2)). Since core 0bd6570 no pack derives alive/1: it is the character block’s fact or a playthrough’s, retracted by a death, so its absence is not a death. A reader that read `\+ alive(P)` as "P has died" now reads a POSITIVE death fact: dead/1 (the character block’s, emitted when isAlive is false; what a simulation states for its dead, who are not person/1 there) or deceased/3 (a death at run time), with no alive/1 fact. The alive/1 guard is U117(2): a person whose alive/1 fact cannot be retracted still answers alive. Each kb opens with the shipped advanced pack (src/prolog/advanced-predicates.ts) verbatim, comment and blank lines dropped, or with npc-reasoning, ToTT and the advanced pack together where a case says so, then the case’s world facts; consult the kb, run the query, and compare the solutions as a multiset. Regenerate with `npm run alive-negation-corpus`. Every case pins needs_quest(rescue, P, L). event_candidate(funeral, P, L) reads a death the same way since PL.core-dead-readers; its cases, and schedule/4’s, are in conformance/prolog/death-readers.json. The scaffold generator’s genealogy goals (the_line_ends and the the_world_turns mayor gate, src/scaffold/scaffold-generation.ts) are the other fixed readers: their cases are in conformance/prolog/scaffold.json, whose the_line_ends ending is the generator’s spelling.

resource_balance(Location, Resource, Balance) :- resource(Location, Resource, Current), resource_production(Location, Resource, Prod), resource_consumption(Location, Resource, Cons), Balance is Current + Prod - Cons.
has_deficit(Location, Resource) :- resource_balance(Location, Resource, B), B < 0.
has_surplus(Location, Resource) :- resource_balance(Location, Resource, B), B > 0.
starving(Location) :- has_deficit(Location, food), resource(Location, food, F), F < 10.
can_trade_resource(From, To, Resource) :- has_surplus(From, Resource), has_deficit(To, Resource).

optimal_trade(From, To, Resource, Amount) :- resource_balance(From, Resource, Surplus), Surplus > 0, resource_balance(To, Resource, Deficit), Deficit < 0, NegDef is -Deficit, Amount is min(Surplus, NegDef).

production_blocked(Location, Product) :- depends_on(Product, Material), resource(Location, Material, Amount), Amount =< 0.
location_wealth(Location, Wealth) :- findall(V, (resource(Location, R, Amount), resource_price(R, _, Price), V is Amount * Price), Values), insimul_sum_list(Values, Wealth).
over_capacity(Location, Resource) :- resource(Location, Resource, Amount), resource_capacity(Location, Resource, Cap), Amount > Cap.

likely_action(Person, Action, Probability) :- decision_factor(Person, Action, Factor, Weight), personality(Person, Factor, Value), Probability is Value * Weight.

conflict_probability(X, Y, P) :- personality(X, agreeableness, AX), personality(Y, agreeableness, AY), charge(X, Y, C), Aggression is (1.0 - AX) * 0.3 + (1.0 - AY) * 0.3, Hostility is max(0, -C) * 0.01, P is min(1.0, Aggression + Hostility).
trust_probability(X, Y, P) :- personality(X, agreeableness, AX), personality(X, neuroticism, NX), compatibility(X, Y, C), P is AX * 0.4 + (1.0 - NX) * 0.2 + C * 0.4.

cleared(Person, Crime) :- alibi(Person, Crime, Witness), witness(Witness, Crime, credible).
prime_suspect(Person, Crime) :- suspect_for(Person, Crime), evidence_for(Person, Crime, _), \+ cleared(Person, Crime).
